_catatan: Preset gaya komik (owner 2026-11-15). Terinspirasi genre komik terkenal, tetapi prompt tidak menyebut merek, judul, atau tokoh milik penerbit (Marvel, DC, Tintin, dsb.) supaya hasil tidak meniru karya berhak cipta dan tidak ditolak filter. 'wajib' selalu ditambahkan di setiap prompt (faceless, tanpa teks, ruang balon). 'prompt' = gaya gambar Artistly v6. 'render' = tampilan balon dan halaman di komik-render.py. kartun-klasik, minimalis-doodle, retro-pop-art diadaptasi dari dokumen preset-produksi-komik (owner 2026-11-15); bagian ekspresi wajah dokumen itu sengaja dibuang dan diganti gestur karena aturan faceless.
wajib: Every visible human face is a perfectly smooth uninterrupted blank skin-tone surface from forehead to chin, with absolutely no eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose, nostrils, mouth or lips, not a mask; emotions shown only through body language and posture. Heads upright, nobody lying down, no close-up of faces. Hands with five natural fingers. No Prophet, no angels, no depictions of the unseen. No text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no captions, no signage, no watermarks, no logos. Vertical 9:16 composition with full bodies visible, characters in the lower two thirds, a calm uncluttered area in the upper third reserved for speech balloons.
wajib_kosong: Pure landscape and architecture scene only. The image contains absolutely no humans, no human-like figures, no characters, no crowds, no children, no babies, no dolls, no statues, no silhouettes, no living beings at all. No Prophet, no angels, no depictions of the unseen. No text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no captions, no signage, no watermarks, no logos. Vertical 9:16 composition.

superhero-amerika.prompt: 2D comic book art in the classic American superhero comic style, NOT 3D, NOT painterly: thick bold black ink outlines, heavy spot blacks, Ben-Day halftone dot shading, flat vivid primary colors red blue yellow, dramatic low camera angle, punchy rim lighting, printed comic page look.
superhero-amerika.akhir: Art style reminder: flat 2D inked comic book panel with bold black outlines and halftone dots, vintage four-color print.

manga.akhir: Art style reminder: pure monochrome manga ink with screentones, grayscale only, zero color.

kisah-semi3d-boneka.inspirasi: owner 2026-11-17: 'semi 3D boneka'. Tokoh tetap boneka faceless (aman dari wajah VideoExpress), latar dan cahaya realistis sinematik seperti film epik.
kisah-semi3d-boneka.prompt: Cinematic epic film still in semi-3D style. Characters are stylized handcrafted doll figures: smooth matte vinyl skin, simplified rounded shapes, no realistic skin detail, ADULT proportions with head about one sixth of total body height, long arms and legs, NOT chibi. Every man wears a cloth head covering; some of his own hair may show at the edges (curly, wavy, straight, grey, black or brown, as written for each person), never bald and never bareheaded. The world around them is richly detailed and almost photographic: realistic rock, sand, metal, cloth and fire textures, dramatic volumetric light rays, atmospheric haze and dust, epic scale landscapes, deep depth, Hollywood color grading. Animals are stylized and drawn without eyes, smooth fur where eyes would be.
kisah-semi3d-boneka.prompt_kosong: Cinematic epic film still of an empty environment: almost photographic realistic rock, sand, metal and fire textures, dramatic volumetric light rays, atmospheric haze and dust, epic scale, deep depth, Hollywood color grading. The scene is completely empty of humans and figures.
kisah-semi3d-boneka.akhir: Style reminder: stylized doll characters with blank faces and covered heads inside a realistic cinematic world.
kisah-semi3d-boneka.akhir_kosong: Style reminder: empty realistic cinematic environment, no humans.

kisah-sinematik-natural.prompt: Cinematic epic film still, semi-realistic 3D with natural human anatomy. Characters have realistic natural human skin with fine natural texture and subtle pores, natural knuckles, tendons and veins on the hands, realistic weight and posture; skin tone, body build, height, age and muscle definition follow each person's own description (fat, thin, short, tall, old, young, light or dark skin), so people look clearly different from each other like a real population. ADULT proportions with head about one seventh of total body height, NOT chibi, NOT doll, NOT plastic, NOT vinyl. The face area alone stays a perfectly smooth blank skin surface with no features. Every man wears a cloth head covering; some of his own hair may show at the edges (curly, wavy, straight, grey, black or brown, as written for each person), never bald and never bareheaded. The world is richly detailed and almost photographic: realistic rock, sand, metal, cloth and fire textures, dramatic volumetric light rays, atmospheric haze and dust, epic scale landscapes, deep depth, Hollywood color grading. Animals are realistic and drawn without eyes, smooth fur where eyes would be.
kisah-sinematik-natural.prompt_kosong: Cinematic epic film still of an empty environment: almost photographic realistic rock, sand, metal and fire textures, dramatic volumetric light rays, atmospheric haze and dust, epic scale, deep depth, Hollywood color grading. The scene is completely empty of humans and figures.
kisah-sinematik-natural.akhir: Style reminder: natural realistic human skin, every person with his own described body build, height, age and skin tone, blank smooth faces, covered heads, inside a realistic cinematic world.

kisah-3d-realistis.prompt: Cinematic 3D animated feature film still, realistic 3D CGI quality with physically based materials. Characters have natural human skin with fine texture, natural hands with five fingers, realistic weight and posture; body build, height, age and skin tone follow each person's own description so people look clearly different. ADULT proportions with head about one seventh of body height, NOT chibi, NOT doll, NOT plastic. Head covering and hair exactly as written for each person (bare head when written none). Richly detailed believable world with clear architecture, cinematic key light, soft atmospheric depth, rich natural colour grade.
kisah-3d-realistis.wajib: FACELESS: every human face is a smooth blank skin surface with absolutely no eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose, nostrils, mouth or lips, while keeping the natural sculpted 3D head shape with soft cheek, jaw and chin volume and natural shading, like a smooth sculpted face; never a flat oval patch, never a mask. The blank face may be seen from the front, three-quarter, profile and in close-up. Emotions through posture, head angle, shoulders and hands. Hands with five natural fingers. No Prophet, no angels, no depictions of the unseen. No text, no letters, no captions, no signage, no watermarks, no logos. Vertical 9:16 composition.
kisah-3d-realistis.prompt_kosong: Cinematic 3D animated feature film still of an empty environment, realistic 3D CGI quality, physically based materials, clear readable architecture, cinematic key light, soft atmospheric depth, rich natural colour grade. kisah-3d-realistis.akhir: Style reminder: realistic cinematic 3D, every person with his own described build, height, age, skin tone and head covering, smooth sculpted blank faces with natural head shape.
